attack_surface_map.meaning: A guard checks available funds before all mutations complete.
Two account-like values are mutated as separate effects.
Missing or weak amount validation lets invalid values invert the transfer.
A transaction or lock boundary is required for durable mitigation.

trace_summary.backend_parity: Uses the same public invariant as the live backend: a finding becomes certifiable only when at least 3 independent universe profiles converge on the same vulnerability family.

evidence_sources.note: Run audit_code(source_code) against the backend for the live simulation; this certificate keeps the same convergence invariant for judge-repeatable Copilot/MCP review.

universe_votes.name: Economic Extractor
universe_votes.attacker_model: looks for value-transfer paths that can be drained repeatedly
universe_votes.rationale: check-then-write transfer can be repeated before balances settle

universe_votes.name: Race-Condition Hunter
universe_votes.attacker_model: looks for check-then-write interleavings and stale guards
universe_votes.rationale: guard and mutation are not protected by a transaction or lock

universe_votes.name: Invariant Breaker
universe_votes.attacker_model: looks for invalid values that invert balance or authorization logic
universe_votes.rationale: negative, NaN, or infinite amount can invert expected balance movement

universe_votes.name: Insider Mutator
universe_votes.attacker_model: looks for direct state mutation without an authority boundary
universe_votes.rationale: caller can mutate account-like objects without an explicit authority boundary

universe_votes.name: Regression Fossilizer
universe_votes.attacker_model: looks for patterns that should become reusable lint rules
universe_votes.rationale: pattern is reusable enough to fossilize as a lint rule

initial_certificate.invariant: A finding is certifiable only when at least 3 independent universe profiles arrive at the same vulnerability family.
initial_certificate.recommended_patch_strategy: Validate amount, move balance changes into a transaction/lock, and preserve the pattern as an ESLint rule.
